topics.title: Jensen Huang ousted as Nvidia CEO following scandal
topics.explanation: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned after reports emerged of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of spying for China. The company has appointed finance chief Colette Kress as interim CEO while it searches for a permanent replacement.
topics.why_it_matters: As the central figure of the AI infrastructure boom, Huang's sudden departure creates significant uncertainty for the world's most valuable chipmaker and the broader artificial intelligence industry.

topics.title: Microsoft services hit by global outage
topics.explanation: Microsoft is working to restore access to services including Outlook and Teams following a major global outage. The company stated the disruption was not caused by malicious or cyber activity.
topics.why_it_matters: The outage has significantly impacted business and government communications worldwide, forcing some traders and companies to rely on alternative methods like phones and faxes.

topics.title: Bond yields surge as inflation concerns rise
topics.explanation: Treasury yields are rising as investors react to October inflation data that exceeded expectations and concerns over a more hawkish Federal Reserve. The move has reversed recent gains in the bond market.
topics.why_it_matters: Higher bond yields generally increase borrowing costs for companies and consumers, which can put downward pressure on stock valuations.

topics.title: Global oil markets see production surge
topics.explanation: Oil markets have shifted toward a surplus as Iraq's production reached its highest level since 2019 and UAE output remained high. The increase in supply comes despite ongoing shipping disruptions in the Middle East.
topics.why_it_matters: Fluctuations in global oil supply and prices directly impact energy costs and can influence broader market sentiment and inflation expectations.
